liebermann.notes: Glanvill (f. 5–73, c. 1210), then, after a later-inserted 14th-century collection of 13th–14th-century statutes (f. 74–212), originally directly following in the same hand, f. 213 ECf to 34,1a (class adow), ending the volume.

entries.text_de: British Museum Additional 24066. f. 5—73 Glanvilla, um 1210, dann (hinter einer später mitten hineingehefteten Sammlung der Statuten 13. 14. Jhs., vom 14. Jh., die f. 74—212 füllt) ursprünglich unmittelbar folgend in ders. Hd.: f. 213 ECf bis 34, 1a4, u. S. 627. Vgl. adow. Ende des Bandes.
entries.text_en: British Museum Additional 24066. ff. 5—73 Glanvill, c. 1210; then (after a collection of 13th- and 14th-century statutes, of the 14th century, later sewn into the middle, which fills ff. 74—212), originally following immediately, in the same hand: f. 213 ECf to 34, 1a4, below, p. 627. Cf. adow. End of the volume.

notes.text_de: vgl. Liebermann Über Leges Ed. Conf. S. 125.
notes.text_en: cf. Liebermann, Über Leges Ed. Conf. p. 125.
